notes:
Describes having more than enough of something, particularly resources, funds, or supplies. Carries a positive connotation of comfortable abundance, often used in business and economic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潤沢|じゅんたく}な⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧: ample funds
- {潤沢|じゅんたく}な⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧: abundant resources
- {潤沢|じゅんたく}な⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: generous budget
- {潤沢|じゅんたく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use liberally

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧: abundant — more common in everyday speech, broader usage
- ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧: rich, plentiful — emphasizes natural richness or fertility
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧: sufficient, enough — neutral, simply means meeting a requirement
